message.content: In Christian theology, the emphasis on prophets varies across traditions and individual beliefs. While many Christians regard Jesus Christ as the central and ultimate revelation of God—often described as the “prophet, priest, and king” in the New Testament—other figures such as Moses, Isaiah, and John the Baptist also hold significant prophetic roles within the biblical narrative. Ultimately, how one ranks these figures depends on theological perspective, denominational teachings, and personal faith convictions.
